incident.description: E Line signal failure: no trains leave Expo Park/USC from minute 10 to minute 25.

[Venue stewards / LAPD] Steer 80% of the north plaza to shuttles (normally 40%)

briefing: The 15-minute forecast shows the walkway to Expo Park/USC station approaching the danger threshold (predicted density 4.53 at minute 17). The most_margin plan holds the crowd at 800/min release, adds 5 extra trains per hour and 38 extra buses, and steers 80% of north‑plaza fans to shuttles plus 20% of east‑gate exits south. Approval deadline is minute 6.
reason: It keeps peak density well below the 5‑person/m² threshold (2.4) while only modestly extending clear time, and its approval window (4 minutes left) is the longest of the safe options.
